ITEM 1 | Cubes of pale off-white/cream solid food, roughly 1–1.5 cm pieces, with light tan edges and a matte, slightly firm surface; cut into uniform dice and piled in a mound at upper-left of the plate, partly overlapping the potatoes | 95
ITEM 2 | Roasted potato wedges/chunks, golden-brown with darker caramelized spots on the cut and skin edges, firm and dry-looking, roughly 3–4 cm pieces, clustered at left-center of the plate | 130
ITEM 3 | Creamy, flaky off-white mixture with small green leafy flecks (chopped greens), moist and clumpy, sits in a loose mound at center-right of the plate and spreads slightly | 110
ITEM 4 | Flat, thin, tan-to-golden pieces with ragged edges and slightly glossy, moist surface, lying at lower-right of the plate, with a sprig of fine green herb sprouting from the top | 75
ITEM 5 | Loose dark-green leafy pieces, finely chopped, scattered within the creamy mixture and near the right-center of the plate | 15
ITEM 6 | Small scattered crumbs and bits of pale tan food on the plate rim, mostly on the adjacent plate at left | 5
